svg.title: Josh Botha, developer in Sydney. Ask me about my work: web and app design, systems design, data design, AI implementation, finance and BI, medical science.

g.text: Websites and app interfaces for the web, desktop and
phones, from the first layout to the motion.
I map every system and manual step, then design and
build the one system that connects them.
Data modelled so every number has an owner, a source
and a period, for reports, apps and AI.
Assistants and agents on a team's own data. Agents draft,
and a person approves anything that leaves.
Weekly P&Ls that build themselves, board packs, and the
systems behind them, reconciled to the cent.
Medical science and finance at the University of Sydney,
